# fmt 11.2.0

Unmodified args.h, base.h, format.h and format-inl.h from the official 11.2.0 tag:
https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/tree/11.2.0/include/fmt

LICENSE is copied unchanged from the same tag. Header-only, used by vasrun and vasbuild via samples/common/vas_format.h.
The type-only validator uses fmt parser internals; upgrades must rerun format validation tests.
The AngelScript core does not depend on fmt.
Builds are offline; no runtime DLL or network dependency.
